headline: Approved new all-alcohol on-premises liquor license for Urban Soccer (Malden) LLC at 735 Broadway, 3-0.
summary: The board reviewed a new all-alcohol, on-premises liquor license application from Urban Soccer (Malden) LLC for 735 Broadway. Esquire Nicholas Zozula and owner Roman Claverie-Castetnau explained alcohol service rules, including wristbands for field access and food service. The board approved the license 3 Yea, 0 Nay.
decisions: Approved a new All Alcohol, On-Premises License for Urban Soccer (Malden) LLC at 735 Broadway, 3 Yea 0 Nay.

decision_evidence.quote: The board voted to approve the License for Urban Soccer (Malden) LLC. Motion made by Andrew Zieberg, Seconded by Denise Balboni-Cowie. 3 Yea 0 Nay

plain_text:
CITY OF MALDEN
MASSACHUSETTS
Liquor Licensing Board
Meeting Minutes
Date: September 15, 2026
 Time: 6:00 PM Room 108
Members in Attendance:                        Also in Attendance:
Kevin Molis- Chairman Gia Finocchiaro
Denise Balboni-Cowie Cpt. Paul Hopkins
Andrew Zieberg
Meeting Called to Order: 6:10 PM
Called to Order By: Kevin Molis
Seconded By: Denise Balboni-Cowie
Approval of Minutes: From August 18,2026
Motion: Denise Balboni-Cowie
2nd: Andrew Zieberg
The following were considered for approval:
1. The Licensing Board received a New All Alcohol, On-Premises License, 
from Urban Soccer (Malden) LLC located at 735 Broadway. Esquire 
Nicholas Zozula from McDermott, Quilty, Miller & Hanley LLP was 
present along with his client Roman Claverie-Castetnau owner and on-
site manager for Urban Soccer. Esq. Zozula presented the proposed 
license to the board explaining that Mr. Claverie-Castetnau owns multiple
locations across France, United States, and Canada. Recently he just 
opened another location in South Boston that also has a liquor license 
and has been very successful. Mr. Claverie-Castetnau will be the on-site 
manager splitting his time between Malden and South Boston location. 
When Mr. Claverie-Castetnau is in South Boston his assistant manager 
will be in charge, this person has the same responsibilities as Mr. 
Claverie-Castetnau. All employees will be T.I.P.S. Certified. Alcohol will 
not be permitted outside the location on the outdoor fields. Alcohol will 
only be served in the bar/lounge area and if customer choose to walk to a
field to watch a match they will need a wristband (at the boards required 
condition) showing that they are 21+ and able to consume alcohol.
Esq. Zozula and Mr. Claverie-Castetnau also explained that this is not a 
bar where patrons will come in only to drink. It is more for while they are 
there enjoying an event taking place at the arena. Mr. Claverie-Castetnau
will also be serving quick food for example; small pizzas, chicken tenders,
chips and other food to be consumed.
The board voted to approve the License for Urban Soccer (Malden) LLC.
Motion made by Andrew Zieberg, Seconded by Denise Balboni-Cowie.
3 Yea 0 Nay
Meeting adjourned at:
Time: 6:47 PM
Motion By: Denise Baldoni-Cowie
Seconded By: Andrew Zieberg
Minutes respectfully submitted by: Gia Finocchiaro – Liquor Licensing Clerk
